what: For lane may-suspend (docs/v2/plan/lanes/may-suspend.md, section The check, which has the error text): call `hir_ty_suspend::suspend_check(db, krate)` in a crate's check, after its bodies check, and lower its `Found` into errors (errors, not lints). `Held` -> "`<binding>` (`<ty>`) is held across a call that may suspend this fiber": primary span `call` (label "this may suspend: <path_said()>"), secondary `made` ("held from here"); note by `why` (NotSend: "the job may resume on another thread, and `<ty>` is not `Send`"; MustNotSuspend(adt): "... and `<adt>` is `#[must_not_suspend]`"); help "end its scope before the call (a block around its uses), or take what you need out of it first" (a guard borrowed and then moved is still held, as under rustc's .await). A temporary (binding None) is named "a temporary of type `<ty>`". `Broken` with Promise::Dyn{method, concrete} -> "`<concrete>` as `dyn <trait>` may suspend in `<method>`, which is not `#[blaze::may_suspend]`" (method None: its drop), path note; Promise::Pointer -> "a function that may suspend is made a function pointer outside a `#[blaze::may_suspend]` field"; Promise::Unseen(u) -> "can't tell whether this may suspend: <u.said()>". `no_send` -> "this crate graph parks fibers (corosensei) but has no `core::marker::Send`". Spans are MirSpan in `owner`'s body, as the borrow checker's are. Depends on the coordinator's workspace entry for hir-ty-suspend and on 01443/01444 landing (until then hir-ty-suspend exports nothing). Tell lane may-suspend (window may-suspend) when done. Order: land this with or after 01445 (sched: markers on Here::wait/relocate and Cx: Sync); before it, blaze-graph's own jobs hold &Cx (!Sync today) across waits and its crate check would fail. Lints that read the same facts (suspend_points, may_suspend_at, on_fiber) are no-fallback-front's (01497).
